title: Chat and messaging
prompt: Design a chat app with one-to-one and group conversations and real-time delivery.
key_points: Used persistent connections (WebSockets) through a gateway tier, with a session store mapping users to gateways
Guaranteed ordering per conversation (sequence numbers), not globally
Stored before delivering and deduped retries on a client-generated message ID (at-least-once, idempotent)
Handled offline users: push notifications, then sync by cursor on reconnect
Partitioned message storage by conversation in a store suited to append-heavy range reads
Addressed group fan-out, presence without a broadcast storm, or gateway failure and reconnect storms
